## Safety checklist

- [ ] No private product source code added
- [ ] No private repository history added
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, keys or private URLs added
- [ ] No customer or personal code added
- [ ] No real project scanning introduced
- [ ] No file writes introduced
- [ ] No patch apply introduced
- [ ] No telemetry introduced by default

- [ ] Checked spelling and wording
- [ ] Checked screenshots/assets for private information
- [ ] Not applicable
